technical.summary: Multiple short-term bullish confluences (Hull flip, MACD crossover, three white soldiers) offset by weak trend structure (low ADX), price below 200-SMA, and subaverage volume—suitable for swing entry with caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (223.84) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 69 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.
